value.rationale: Determines complete natural all-order AP correlation family for arbitrary generalized paperfolding instructions and proves sharp smallest four-site diameter detecting fold information. Explicit multiscale four-site products recover the entire instruction sequence up to unavoidable global sign, giving a substantive inverse invariant and rigorous limit to diffraction-like data.
